about: Get an attested certificate that a student is still studying in a public school.
note: Requirements read from the official MOE service page on the checked date. MOE fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Study continuation certificate. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For students in public schools and private schools that follow the ministry curriculum
Not available on the student portal during the summer break after the year ends
channels: MOE website or smart app, sign in with UAE PASS
Certificate is sent to the email on the UAE PASS account
